title: Production releases fail, so merged fixes have not reached people
whatHappens: Every production release since 07:00 UTC on 4 Nov stopped at the server step, so fixes merged after v0.1.142 (including #3419 and #3408) are not live.

fixes.text: Release repairs merged (#3492, #3494, #3503, #3505); the next attempt still failed at a migration lock timeout
Skip drops and NOT NULL changes already done (#3529) and run the router schemas the shipped code reads (#3530); open

observations.text: Release issues 3493, 3502, 3504, 3516, 3528: 5 attempts from 07:00 to 11:12 UTC; the first failed on the previous server source lookup, the last at migration 152 on a lock timeout behind a long agent command query.
